work_planning.limits: Experienced-reader planning only; excludes learning prerequisites and repairing discovered flaws. Page ranges overlap. Actual time is unmeasured and no deadline forces approval.

completion_rule: A-D read and accepted by an actual author, or concrete issues repaired and then accepted; E accepts the bounded claims and disclosures and addresses specific known conflicts.
